dureeCelib.introTitre: How long will you stay single?
dureeCelib.introTexte: Answer about your life as it is today, not the one you'd like to have. The test starts from twenty very simple things: your age, your nights out, your friends, what you do when someone catches your eye... and turns them into a number of months.
dureeCelib.resultatLibelle: Based on your answers, you'll probably stay single for

dureeCelib.r1_d: You go out, you see people and you dare to approach them. That's exactly what makes a meeting happen. There's almost nothing to change. Just keep an eye on the people you already come across.
dureeCelib.r1_a: Don't turn every night out into a search. People like you because you're relaxed. Keep it that way.
dureeCelib.r2_d: Your life leaves room for meeting people. It just needs a small push, often on the side of taking the first step or seeing new faces. Look at what's holding you back above: changing one thing can save you several months.
dureeCelib.r2_a: Next time someone catches your eye, say something to them. Any ordinary sentence will do. That's how a lot of stories begin.
dureeCelib.r3_t: Around a year, maybe a bit more
dureeCelib.r3_d: Nothing is blocking you, but nothing is pushing either. You often see the same people. Meeting someone means coming across new people. That's where you can save time.
dureeCelib.r3_a: Add just one new thing to your month. A group activity, a party at a friend of a friend's... Just one, but every month.
dureeCelib.r4_d: Your daily life leaves few chances to meet someone. It isn't about charm. It's mostly about how many people you come across, and for now there aren't many.
dureeCelib.r4_a: Start with your friends rather than the apps. Let the people around you know you're open to meeting someone. Lots of couples start that way.
dureeCelib.r5_t: If nothing changes, it could take a while
dureeCelib.r5_d: With the life you lead today, meeting someone is unlikely to happen on its own. This number is about your current habits. It isn't about you, and habits can change.
dureeCelib.r5_a: Pick the point shown above and stick with it for three months. Then take the test again: you'll see the number move!
